scientific_integrity: All displayed probabilities follow from a finite-dimensional spectral proof; numerical and exact examples corroborate but do not substitute for the proof. Literature priority has residual uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: Finite primitive strongly regular simple graphs; single-excitation continuous-time uniform hopping; exactly two nonzero absorbing rates; no finite-time, noisy, or multisink claims. Accessible historical overlap checks do not establish absolute priority.
title: Two-sink capture universality and site-resolved absorption on primitive strongly regular quantum networks
